response.sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST(UnitPrice AS DECIMAL(18,6))) AS AverageUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
  AND Bytes IS NOT NULL
  AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “Taking 10323804 bytes as the cutoff for a large track” means Bytes is at least 10323804. Missing values are excluded from both averages by filtering out rows with missing Bytes, Milliseconds, or UnitPrice.

  AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL;
